annotations.title: Rank states by assisted living supply or HUD loans

description: Ranks the 50 states and DC on one measure: licensed capacity or facilities from state lists (13 states), CDC residential care communities, beds, residents, dementia-unit or Medicaid-certified share, or HUD 232 assisted living activity (active loans, outstanding balance, loans at 5%+, endorsements since FY2001). Returns value, rank and state page.

order.description: desc = largest first (default), asc = smallest first.
